htnew.py.summary: Create a minimal ``index.html`` template in the current directory.
details: Writes a small HTML5 skeleton (doctype, charset, viewport, title, ``<h1>`` placeholder) to ``index.html`` and prints where it was created.

image_deduper.py.summary: Find visually duplicate images with perceptual hashing and keep the largest copy.
details: Computes the ``imagehash`` pHash of every JPEG/PNG/WebP/TIFF below the current directory, groups the images whose hashes match, keeps the one with the most pixels and deletes the rest. ``DRY_RUN`` is on by default, so only the report is printed until it is turned off.

imagetotext.py.summary: OCR the images below the current directory and keep only readable results.
details: Runs Tesseract with the English, Persian and Russian data (several page-segmentation settings), keeps the output only when it looks like real words and writes ``<image>.txt`` next to the image. Existing text files are skipped unless ``OVERWRITE`` is enabled; the images are processed in parallel.

img2asci.py.summary: Render images as ASCII art in the terminal.
details: Uses ``ascii_magic`` to convert each image to coloured art that fills the terminal width; without arguments every JPEG/PNG/BMP/WebP file below the current directory is rendered via a worker pool.

img2txt.py.summary: OCR images and collect the extracted text per image.
details: Converts each image with pytesseract, filters the lines that contain plausible words and reports the text it found. Files are processed in a pool; the work is independent of the ``tesseract`` CLI.

imgoptim.py.summary: Optimize JPEG, PNG and SVG files in place with the external tools that are installed.
details: Runs jpegoptim (or mogrify), pngquant/optipng and svgo over every matching file below the root, validating that each result still decodes before replacing the original. ``--dry-run`` reports the savings without writing, ``--only`` restricts the file kinds and the remaining options are passed through to the tools; work happens in a process pool.

imgviewer.py.summary: Show an image in the terminal with 256-colour half-block characters.
details: Resizes the image to 100 rows wide (twice as many columns, to compensate for the character aspect ratio) and prints every pixel as a 256-colour background span.

imports4.py.summary: Build a ``requirements.txt`` from the imports a project actually uses.
details: Parses the Python files and notebooks of the target tree, maps the imported module names to distributions with the local PyPI index (``/sdcard/data/pip.json``) plus a cached online lookup, and writes the requirement lines (optionally pinned to the installed versions). ``--ignore-dir``/``--ignore-file``/``--exclude`` filter the scan, ``--dry-run`` and ``--stdout`` avoid touching the file.

initmat.py.summary: Scaffold a PyO3/maturin Rust extension project in the current directory.
details: Writes ``Cargo.toml``, ``src/lib.rs`` (a ``sum_as_string`` example bound with pyo3) and ``pyproject.toml`` configured for the maturin build backend, deriving the crate name from the argument or the directory name.

inject_wheel_to_pip_cache.py.summary: Put a local wheel into pip's HTTP cache so pip can install it offline.
details: Copies the wheel into the ``pip cache dir`` layout that matches a ``file://`` URL, computes the sha224 cache key pip expects and writes the JSON metadata next to it, extracted from the wheel's ``METADATA`` file.

isnude.py.summary: Move the images detected as nude into a ``nude`` folder.
details: Runs the ``nude`` detector over the JPEG/PNG/WebP files (optionally downscaling large images with ``-r``), prints the verdict and renames the positives into ``./nude``.
Keeps the original as ``script.sh.bak``, reads it with the Latin-1 codec and writes the decoded text back as UTF-8.
iso8859toutf8.py.notes: The file name is fixed in the module; copy or adapt it for other targets.

isporn.py.summary: Classify the images in the current directory with the NudeNet detector.
details: Runs ``NudeDetector().detect`` on every JPEG/PNG/WebP file, prints the predicted class and score and skips images that already live in the ``porn``/``nude``/``sexy``/``safr`` folders. The three target folders are created up front.

java_serialization_data_converter.py.summary: Convert a Java serialized binary into JSON.
details: Parses the stream with ``javaobj``, turns the Java objects and strings into dictionaries (dropping the internal fields) and writes the list to the requested JSON file.
